selectionRationale: Keep the semantic boundary explicit and use the mandated 0.75 AI-needed and 0.80 locally-sufficient confidence thresholds in production. The expanded deterministic corpus now provides an offline regression gate, while live evidence remains recorded separately: a 20-entry classifier.dev probe ranked semantic-v2/direct-v1 ahead of the shorter alternatives on exact-label safety, but its exact AI recall was too low to promote a new threshold; provider-routing safety remained the relevant fail-safe because uncertain decisions still go to the provider. No production formulation or threshold is changed without a complete live corpus/grid run.
